visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with medium-length black hair wearing a beige tuxedo and black bowtie stands against a plain white wall, smiling and gesturing with his hands. (2) A person wearing a long brown wig, white off-the-shoulder wedding dress, and lace gloves sits on a brown leather sofa, speaking with exaggerated facial expressions. (3) A man in a black tuxedo and silver bowtie stands near a doorway, pointing behind him while talking. (4) Close-up shots of the groom in the beige suit and the bride in the wedding dress are intercut; they look panicked or frustrated. (5) A green plastic bag sits alone on a brown sofa in a bright room. (6) A person with a blonde bob wig and floral dress stands against a wall, gesturing with a thumbs-up. (7) Split-screen shows the groom on the left and the bride on the right, both pointing upwards. (8) A green paper bag with the Uber Eats logo is handed to the groom; he pulls out a white paper. (9) The bride holds a hot dog with mustard and ketchup while wearing her wedding dress. (10) Outdoors in a grassy field, a man in a red and white priest robe with a grey wig stands before the groom and bride. (11) The groom and bride exchange white cards (vows). (12) A man in a grey hoodie and brown beanie interrupts, pointing aggressively. (13) The groom and the man in the hoodie crouch on a stone path, using yellow and red toy launchers to release spinning tops onto a plastic sheet. (14) The spinning tops collide; the man in the hoodie reacts with despair.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 male actor performing all roles through costume changes and editing.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male actor appearing as a groom in a beige tuxedo, a bride in a white wedding dress and wig, a best man in a black tuxedo, a bridesmaid in a floral dress, a priest in red robes, and an ex-boyfriend in a grey hoodie.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a fast-paced, high-pitched male voice performing multiple roles in quick succession, characterized by exaggerated emotional delivery. (2) A cheerful orchestral wedding-style BGM plays in the background, maintaining a moderate tempo. (3) A distinct 'ding-dong' doorbell sound effect triggers, followed by a transition to a split-screen vocal interaction. (4) The BGM shifts to a more intense, rhythmic synth-driven track as the ex-boyfriend character enters. (5) Mechanical clicking and clashing sound effects of toy spinning tops dominate the mix during the 'battle' sequence. (6) The video concludes with a soft musical stinger accompanying the brand slogan delivery.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook (Forgotten wedding items) -> Comedic Escalation (Uber Eats as the universal solution) -> Absurd Conflict (The Duel) -> Branding Resolution.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously demonstrate the variety of items available on Uber Eats by showing it can solve even the most ridiculous wedding-day emergencies.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent display of the Uber Eats logo and the slogan 'Uber Eats (應該) 都點得到' at the end.
